title: Label-free imaging for cardiomyocyte differentiation from human pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Take hPSCs cultured on 6-well plates in mTeSR1 medium at 80–90% confluence.
Aspirate the medium and add 1 mL of room-temperature Accutase to each well.
Incubate the plate in a 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator for 8 min.
Add 1 ml of mTeSR1 into each well and pool all cells in a 15-ml conical tube.
Count the total cell number with a hemocytometer.
Centrifuge the cells at 200g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant, resuspend the cells in mTeSR1 + 10 μM Y27632.
Replate the cells at a density ranging from 1.3 × 10^5 cells/cm^2 to 2.5 × 10^6 cells/cm^2 onto Matrigel-coated 24-well ibidi u-plate.
Aspirate the medium in each well on day −1 of differentiation and replace it with fresh room temperature mTeSR1 medium.
Repeat the medium replacement until day 0 before initiating differentiation.
On differentiation day 0, initiate cardiomyocyte differentiation by changing the medium to RPMI + B27 minus insulin supplemented with CHIR99021 (ranging from 6 μM to 12 μM).
Aspirate the medium and replace it with fresh room temperature RPMI + B27 minus insulin 24 hours post treatment of CHIR99021.
On differentiation day 3, aspirate the medium.
Replace it with RPMI + B27 minus insulin supplemented with 5 μM IWP2.
On differentiation day 5, aspirate the medium.
Replace it with RPMI + B27 minus insulin.
On differentiation day 7, aspirate the medium.
Replace it with RPMI + B27.
Repeat this process every other day until differentiation day 12.
Record autofluorescence dynamics of NAD(P)H and FAD by OMI on differentiation day 0 using an Ultima two-photon imaging system.
Image cells immediately pre-treatment with CHIR99021 (Wnt signaling activator).
Perform OMI again on day 1, 24 hours post-treatment with CHIR99021.
Record autofluorescence dynamics of NAD(P)H and FAD by OMI on differentiation day 3 immediately pre-treatment with IWP2 (Wnt signaling inhibitor).
Image cells on day 5, 48 hours post-treatment with IWP2.
Turn on the master switch.
Turn off room lights.
Turn on the power for the PMTs 1 and 2.
Turn on the computer.
Open Prairie View Software.
Turn on the laser.
Open the shutter.
Turn on power meter.
Set the Nikon TI-E microscope to E100 and BF.
Turn on the bright field light.
Place a drop of water on the objective.
Place your sample in the holder.
Bring the objective up to your sample and focus onto cells.
Turn off bright field light.
Switch microscope to 720LP and R100.
Turn off the display light on the microscope.
Close the light box.
Change the save path so the images go to the right folder.
Check that acquisition mode is set to FLIM.
Check that averaging is set to 60s.
Check resolution (usually 256×256).
Check pixel dwell time (usually 4.8 µs).
Check optical zoom (usually 1).
On Imaging window select Ch 2.
Under Laser set wavelength at 750 nm.
Under Power/Gain Set PMT 2 at 800.
Set Pockels to 80.
Check that power meter is set to 750.
Click Live Scan.
Adjust Pockels and field of view.
Click Single Scan and wait for it to finish.
On Imaging window select Ch 1.
Under Laser set wavelength at 890 nm.
Under Power/Gain Set PMT 1 at 800.
Set Pockels to 100.
Check that power meter is set to 890.
Click Live Scan.
Adjust Pockels to brighten image.
Click Single Scan and wait for it to finish.
Record Objective in Imaging Notes.
Record Resolution in Imaging Notes.
Record Pixel Dwell time in Imaging Notes.
Record Optical zoom in Imaging Notes.
Record PMT Setting in Imaging Notes.
Record NADH Starting Pockels in Imaging Notes.
Record NADH Power in Imaging Notes.
Record FAD Starting Pockels in Imaging Notes.
Record FAD Power in Imaging Notes.
Try to keep the power the same, not necessarily the pockels.
Check that the CFD is between 1e5 and 1e6 while imaging.
Acquire an IRF with urea crystals for FAD wavelength (890).
Set NADH PMT 2 to 800.
Set Pockels low (15 max) for acquiring IRF.
Make sure microscope is set to E100 and BF before turning off the system.
Take off the sample before turning off the system.
Clean the objective before turning off the system.
Turn off the light.
Turn off the PMTs.
Close the laser shutter.
Turn off the laser.
Close out of Prairie View Software.
Turn off the computer.
Flip the big switch on the back of the computer stand.
